title: NEET UG 2026 Re-Exam: Over 20 Lakh Candidates, 5,440 Centres - How NTA Pulled It Off
description: NEET UG 2026 Re-Exam: The examination was conducted under a multi-layer security framework, including Aadhaar-based biometric and facial authentication, CCTV surveillance, electronic jammers, and two-layer frisking with support from State Police.
